channel.title: Proxly Updates
channel.description: Updates for Proxly - Smart Browser Chooser

item.title: Version 1.2.2
item.description:
• **Sandbox Removal**: Removed app sandbox restrictions to enable full profile support and browser launching capabilities
  • **Browser Profile Support**: Launch specific browser profiles (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Brave)
  • **Advanced Browser Targeting**: Configure custom arguments and profile-specific routing
  • **Profile Detection System**: Automatic detection of installed browser profiles
  • **Profile Permission Management**: Handle macOS privacy permissions for profile access
  • **License Management**: Gumroad-based licensing system for non-App Store builds
  • **Enhanced URL Processing**: Improved pattern matching with URL path support
  • **Handoff/Continuity Support**: Seamless URL transfer from iOS devices
  • **Automatic Updates**: Integrated Sparkle framework for app updates
  • **Profile Selection UI**: Interactive browser and profile selection interface
  • **Custom Arguments Support**: Advanced browser configuration with command-line arguments
  • **Pattern Matching**: Extended domain patterns to support URL paths and subdomains
  • **Rule System**: Migrated from simple browser identifiers to comprehensive BrowserTarget system
  • **UI Components**: New profile-aware selection panels and configuration views
  • **Onboarding Flow**: Added license validation step for non-App Store builds
  • **Settings Management**: Profile features toggle and advanced configuration options
  • **Localization**: Updated all language files with new profile-related strings
  • **Keychain Integration**: Secure storage for license keys and sensitive data
  • **Permission Handling**: Proper macOS privacy permission requests for profile access
  • **Hardened Runtime**: Enhanced security for notarized builds
  • **Entitlements Simplified**: Removed sandbox restrictions for enhanced functionality while maintaining security through code signing and notarization
  • **Architecture Refactoring**: New BrowserTarget and BrowserProfile model system
  • **Profile Handlers**: Specialized handlers for Chrome, Edge, Firefox, and Brave profiles
  • **Launch Methods**: Multiple browser launching strategies with graceful degradation
  • **Error Handling**: Comprehensive error management for profile operations
  • **Migration Support**: Backward compatibility for existing rule configurations
  • **Build System**: Updated to build 24 with enhanced project configuration
  • **Menu Bar Integration**: Improved status bar behavior and license-aware functionality
  • **App Lifecycle**: Better handling of onboarding completion and license validation
  • **URL Processing**: Enhanced Handoff URL handling and processing flow
  • **Entitlements**: Simplified entitlements for better compatibility
  • **Logger**: Improved logging system with OSLog integration
